CMSIS headers were copied from the board vendor's SDRAM example, downloaded during
the board review. The original license files are retained next to the headers.

Source: https://github.com/bitboardir/STM32H750IBK6-Development-kit-v2.2
Archive: 2-example application/2-SDRAM/stm32h750_7_sdram test_ok.rar

These headers describe STM32H750 registers. The blink program itself is new and
does not use the vendor example's clock, SDRAM, Ethernet or GPIO initialization.
